senses.gloss: (= שגשג = סגסג, denom. of סִיג I) to be debased.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>שְׂגִישְׂתּוּן בי וכ׳</he> you acted basely towards me, as it is said (<cite ref="Psalms 78:36">Ps. LXXVIII, 36</cite>) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 287">Yalk. Is. 287</cite> <he>שגשגישתון ככסף</he> [<cite ref="O00560"><he>סיגים</he></cite>] <he>מצופה על חרס וכ׳</he> (corr. acc., or <he>שַׁגְשְׁגִיתוּן</he>) you were base like ‘an earthen vessel overlaid with silver [dross]’ (<cite ref="Proverbs 26:23">Prov. XXVI, 23</cite>), as it is written (Ps. l. c.) &c.

senses.gloss: to debase. Lev. R. l. c. שַׂגִּישְׂתּוּן אורחא וכ׳ you debased your manners, as it is written (Prov. l. c.), ‘an earthen vessel’ &c.—
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 9a">B. Bath. 9ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>עולא מְשַׂגֵּשׂ ארחתיה דאימיה</he> a child that caused the deterioration of his mother’s ways (who refused his mother’s entreaties until she uncovered her breasts, saying, look at the breasts that gave thee suck).
